title: template.manifest.json
description: Which paths the bht-component-registry template owns. `npx create-bht-component-registry update` reads this file from the TARGET template release and replaces exactly these paths, so the rule is data a new release can change, not a list baked into the CLI.

owned.description: Globs (`**` crosses directories, `*` and `?` stay within one segment) that update may add, replace or remove. Because the root package.json is owned, add dependencies to the workspace package that needs them, not to the root.

never.description: Globs update never touches, even when an `owned` glob also matches them. Your components, your config and your pending changesets live here.

templateOnly.description: Globs that exist in the template repo but must never land in a registry made from it (the create CLI's own source, the template repo's issue and PR templates). `create` skips them; `update` never copies them and removes any left behind by an older template. Checked before `owned`.

readmeMarker.description: The exact line in README.md above which the template's text is replaced on update. Everything from this line down is yours and is kept. A README without the line is left untouched.

rewriteScope.description: Owned files that mention the template's `example` scope. After update copies them, the owner's scope from registry.config.json is re-applied with the same word replace `create` uses.
